_comment: Issue #43 (playtest state boot, debug-only title fixture picker): the picker's OWN canonical proof -- boots straight from a fresh title (no fixture_save harness pre-seed; this script drives the REAL in-game picker end to end, not the QA-only shortcut). Gate -> menu (selectable_rows:3, Continue skipped, no save yet) -> move down 1 lands on 'Playtest States' (debug-build-only row, sits after Continue in ROWS so this navigation is unaffected by Continue's enabled state) -> confirm opens the picker (ui_playtest_list_rendered) -> move right x3 jumps the cursor by a full PLAYTEST_PAGE_SIZE (10) each press, landing on global index 30 (page 4, row 1) -> move down x3 lands on index 33, which PLAYTEST_FIXTURE_ORDER pins to near_garden (a mid-story fixture: Act III reached, warrior 5 + helper 1, standing at the inn bed) -> confirm copies qa/fixtures/near_garden.json into the manual slot (Game.install_fixture_save) and rides the EXISTING Continue-load path (game_loaded, then world_ready from Main's swap). Final assert_state trio proves the fixture's own known state actually landed in the live sim, not just that SOME load succeeded.
